en.title: Sign in to Claude Design Desktop
en.summary: Choose a saved account or add a ChatGPT account through the secure browser flow.

zh.title: 登入 Claude Design Desktop
zh.summary: 選擇已儲存的帳戶，或透過安全瀏覽器流程加入 ChatGPT 帳戶。

en.title: Your accounts
en.summary: Each saved account has an isolated profile and can be selected per project.

zh.title: 你的帳戶
zh.summary: 每個已儲存帳戶都有獨立設定檔，可按專案選用。

en.title: Projects
en.summary: Start from a truthful empty state, then create or open a local project.

zh.title: 專案
zh.summary: 由真實的空白狀態開始，然後建立或開啟本機專案。

en.title: Build a calm design workspace
en.summary: Keep files, conversation, comments, and preview visible without losing the next action.

zh.title: 建立清晰的設計工作區
zh.summary: 檔案、對話、評論和預覽同時可見，下一步不會走失。

en.title: Share with saved accounts
en.summary: The owner chooses explicit viewer, commenter, or editor access for each local account slot.

zh.title: 與已儲存帳戶分享
zh.summary: 擁有者為每個本機帳戶欄位選擇檢視者、評論者或編輯者權限。

en.title: Make the workspace yours
en.summary: Language, theme, density, typography, accessibility, updates, and private local data live here.

zh.title: 讓工作區成為你的樣子
zh.summary: 語言、主題、密度、字體、無障礙、更新和本機私人資料都在這裡。

en.title: Everything has a place
en.summary: Find the universal capabilities, their status, and the next useful action from one searchable surface.

zh.title: 每件事都有位置
zh.summary: 在一個可搜尋的介面查看通用功能、狀態和下一個實用動作。

en.title: Downloading design-export.zip
en.summary: A separate always-on-top surface reports the real transfer, with pause, resume, and cancel.

zh.title: 正在下載 design-export.zip
zh.summary: 獨立的置頂介面顯示真實傳輸，支援暫停、繼續和取消。

en.title: The account service is offline
en.summary: Local projects remain available when the saved account is cached. Generation waits safely until the service returns.

zh.title: 帳戶服務目前離線
zh.summary: 已快取的帳戶仍可開啟本機專案。服務恢復後才會繼續產生工作。
